mainEntity.name: What kind of preparation do I need to do before drywall finishing begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before professional drywall finishing begins, it's essential to ensure the space is ready. This includes confirming all drywall sheets are securely fastened and any necessary repairs to damaged sheets are completed. The work area should be clear of furniture, debris, and other obstacles. Ensure adequate lighting is available, as good visibility is crucial for high-quality finishing. It's also beneficial to maintain a consistent room temperature and humidity, as extreme conditions can affect the drying time and curing of joint compound. Protecting floors and nearby fixtures is also a good practice.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before drywall finishing, ensure drywall is securely fastened and repaired, clear the work area, provide good lighting, and maintain consistent room temperature and humidity.
